Name: Nadab, King of Israel
Summary: Nadab, son of Jeroboam, reigned two years and walked in his father's sin, and was slain by Baasha at Gibbethon while Israel besieged the Philistines.
KeyStory: Nadab follows Jeroboam's sin and is slain by Baasha.
LifeLesson: A son who inherits only his father's sins inherits his father's judgment too.
